referred_to_by.content: The J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles

Brassaï was a studied chronicler of children's delights. In this picture he focused on a boy's giddy rapture with his new purchase, magically floating on a string from his wrist. With the vendor obscured by the volume of his merchandise, the balloons take on an almost mythical quality, dominating the composition like an oversize, overripe bunch of grapes.
